notes.title: Patch Version 1.03a
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that prevented the leaderboards from scrolling.
Fixed a bug where a player quitting the game before start would cause visual anomalies.
Players can invite and join friends to their custom game via Steam's friends list.
Players now return to the lobby when a custom game ends.
Removed the displaying of errors when game fails to fetch admin message.
